initialExam.title: Army Agniveer Tradesman 2026
initialExam.description: Agniveer Tradesman entry for Indian Army in various trades like cook, washerman, barber, house keeper, tailor, and other support roles under the Agnipath scheme.
initialExam.eligibility: 8th pass or 10th pass depending on the trade
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics (basic), English (basic).
initialExam.examPattern: CEE: 50 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes. Objective type.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Registration → Rally (Physical/Medical) → CEE → Trade Test → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer Tradesman in Indian Army (Cook, Washerman, Barber, etc.)
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → 25% retained → Sepoy → Lance Naik → Naik → Havildar.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Attend rally 5. CEE exam
initialExam.perks: Seva Nidhi: ₹11.71 lakh, Medical, Canteen, Free rations and accommodation
